title: Introducing the Agent Experience (AX) Practitioner Playbook
factSummary: Microsoft published a guide to evaluating coding agents, finding causes of errors and testing changes to the sources agents use. It describes a method, not a guarantee of correct code.

title: Claude Platform release notes: October 9, 2026
factSummary: Anthropic announced dynamic workflows in beta for Claude Managed Agents. These programs run agents in phases and combine results, including for work such as reviewing many documents.
